reviews.title: I shouldn’t have subscribed
reviews.text:
I subscribed to this app because I liked being able to rearrange workout and active rest days to fit my schedule, but since March that feature suddenly stopped working despite my subscription still being active.

On top of that, the app has been buggy. It often doesn’t save the weight (lbs) I log for my lifts, and my entries end up disappearing. That makes progress tracking frustrating and unreliable—especially for an app that’s supposed to help with consistency and workout tracking.

What made the experience worse is that there doesn’t seem to be proper support available within the app, so I had to reach out externally just to ask for help.

Because of the ongoing issues, lack of support, and unresolved bugs, I eventually stopped using the app altogether. Disappointing experience for a paid subscription.

reviews.title: Great programs, but…
reviews.text: The app itself is a mess. Losing streaks despite logging every day, steps not being counted correctly despite linking to health app, entered weight changing (I.e. put in 15 lbs for laterals, get 6.8 displayed next time despite not changing from lbs to kg and still reading in lbs), changing exercises for alternatives causes errors in display for supersets, previous weights not being recorded next time I do an exercise, force logged-out mid workout, etc etc. I love what Browney is doing and their programs are great, however the app needs some serious changes. Not sure if it’s just an Apple thing, or if this is universal. Hope to see the app improve to properly match the great workouts and programs.
